name: Herne (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, black and yellow with a broad black middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Herne (a black horse with crossed hammers on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Herne; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Herne arms — horse with hammers on yellow
